(Nasdaq: ODFL) announced today that it plans to release its fourth quarter and year-end 2023 financial results before opening of trading on Wednesday, January 31, 2024. The Company will also hold a conference call to discuss its financial results and outlook at 10:00 a.m. (Eastern Time) on Wednesday, January 31, 2024.
